A goods invoice is €12,000 gross. The supplier credits €216 gross; a separate freight invoice is €753 net. What are the remaining goods liability and net landed cost if the original goods cost €10,000 net and the credit is €180 net?
questions.correctAnswer: Remaining goods liability: €12,000 − €216 = €11,784. Net landed cost: €10,000 − €180 + €753 = €10,573. Freight is a separate liability.
